concern_summary: This concern encompasses the functionalities related to the management and display of page headers for various expense-related operations, including the overview of transaction statuses, user interactions, and navigation options for money requests and expense tracking.
Handling navigation and user feedback for operations related to changes in workspace ownership and policy upgrades, including success and error management.
This concern covers the page headers and functionalities related to managing currency selections and payment card-related options, streamlining the user experience for financial transactions.
This concern addresses the visual and thematic aspects of the page header, including the overall page theme and loading indicators, providing a coherent visual experience.
This concern encompasses the display logic for handling various page states, including not found scenarios and fallback displays when resources are unavailable.
This concern focuses on functionalities related to managing reporting and settlement frequencies for card transactions, ensuring the correct selections are made and updated in associated policies.

This concern deals with ensuring that the user interface on the workspaces page is responsive and properly navigated based on user actions and state management, including conditions for displaying error and not found pages.
Detailed management and display of workspace member information and functionalities, including member details, owner changes, and specific validation processes tied to workspace management.

This concern focuses on managing the settings and preferences related to workspace settlement accounts, including the selection of eligible bank accounts and the frequency of settlements chosen by the user.
